title: Cech cohomology computes cohomology when the covering has vanishing higher cohomology on all intersections
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives the standard criterion under which Cech cohomology of a covering computes cohomology: if the higher cohomology of F vanishes on every fibre product U_{i_0} x_U ... x_U U_{i_p} of members of the covering, then Cech H^p of the covering equals H^p(U, F) (statement lines 1505-1513). The proof identifies the hypothesis with the vanishing of the E_2 terms of the Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence off the row q = 0, so the spectral sequence degenerates and the abutment is the E_2^{p,0} row (proof lines 1516-1520). The content is the correct reading of the hypothesis into the E_2 page. The claim is H2: one spectral-sequence degeneration, no further construction.
